objects.source: V, actual exact prox p_eta(y)=argmin_x(V(x)+norm(x-y)^2/(2*eta)); standard Gaussian G; H_y(G)=gradient V(p_eta(y)+sqrt(eta)*G); g_eta=gradient V_eta; bias b_eta and zero-mean xi_eta.
objects.exact_center: With genuine first integrability, m_y=E_gamma H_y, b_eta=m_y-g_eta and xi_eta=H_y-m_y. The source zero-mean fluctuation is centered at the actual oracle mean, not simply at g_eta.
objects.law_boundary: Gaussian gradient-output is not the true RGO posterior R_eta,y or standardized posterior r_y. Ex9 compares their different expectations, rather than equating laws or means.

domains.source: Full finite Euclidean R^d; standard centered covariance-identity Gaussian N(0,I); eta>0.
domains.normalization: Source target pi is proportional to exp(-V), pi_eta=pi*N(0,eta I); source exp(-V_eta)=exp(-V)*N(0,eta I). Normalized U_eta=V_eta+log Z_V is a constant-shift adapter, not an extra source input; gradients agree.
domains.future_extensions: Finite real Hilbert/Borel coordinate-free and dimension-zero representations need explicit disclosure when a future signature is reviewed; no candidate reviewed here.

quantifiers.printed: For every positive eta, every y and every vector u, E_gamma exp(inner(u,xi_eta(y;G))) <= exp(eta*norm(u)^2/2).
quantifiers.signed_equivalent: For all directions a in R^d and all real t, including negative t, t=0 and a=0: E_gamma exp(t*inner(a,H_y-m_y)) <= exp(eta*t^2*norm(a)^2/2), by u=t*a. No unit-direction or positive-t restriction is printed.
quantifiers.parameter_family_boundary: A jointly measurable parameter family or kernel representation is an explicit elaboration if later proposed, not a printed extra hypothesis or output of this scalar estimate.

assumptions.source: V globally C2, 0<alpha<=beta and actual pointwise Hessian bounds. For this part of the paper beta=1, alpha=kappa^-1 and kappa>=1. Section3.1 supplies eta>0; neighboring Lemma4.1 alone states eta<=1.
assumptions.source_hypothesis_vs_dependency: Actual prox, measurability, Gaussian law, noise Lipschitzness sqrt(eta), own first moment and all-signed exponential domain are derived dependency obligations; their conclusions cannot become extra public source premises.
assumptions.distinct_computational_contract: S2.p2.2 bounds actual numerical proximal calls by eta<=1/(2*beta); this is not the analytic eta range of Lemma4.2.

conclusion.target: Exact printed sharp centered inequality (4.3), with coefficient eta/2 and true own-mean fluctuation.
conclusion.domain_not_estimate: Finite first moment/all-signed centered exponential L1 are prerequisite facts only; they do not prove the sharp MGF bound.
conclusion.bias_distinction: Centering at g_eta alone introduces exp(inner(u,b_eta)) and is not the printed sharp zero-mean conclusion. No unbiasedness assertion.
